evidence.name: Screen field: Points this answer adds
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Points this answer adds" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Points this answer adds
sections.description: The whole number this answer adds to the running total in the target score variable when a visitor selects this option. Give higher-intent answers larger values and weaker ones smaller or zero, for example 'ready to buy' = 10 and 'just browsing' = 1. Keep a consistent scale across all answers so the final total is meaningful for branching or analytics.
